agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is 2 massive bodies (17.1 and 14.8 Msun) with G~4.78 and dt~0.0135. Body 1 starts moving upward toward the stationary massive body 0, entering a very close encounter (distance 0.705 at step 30, 0.428 at step 31, 0.105 at step 32). Softening length is 0.3, so final distance is deep inside softening core. Leapfrog substeps per outer step grow to 12,13,16 but appear capped at 16, insufficient for the rapidly growing acceleration and velocity (speeds 10.7 and 18.5 at step 32). Energy drifts from +25.99 initial to +1.13 at step30, -101.99 at step31, -292.13 at step32, a change of 318 exceeding allowed 146.5, triggering energy_conserved violation. Counterfactual with dt=0.001 (same 32 steps) keeps energy at 25.99 and passes, confirming cause is integration error due to too large dt / insufficient substepping for close approach.
